name: oxplow-foundation-components
description: oxplow-foundation's custom components: built when oxplow is built, deployed with the extension.

scripts.build: bun build src/timeline/main.ts --outdir dist/timeline --entry-naming main.js --format iife --minify && cp src/timeline/index.html src/timeline/timeline.css dist/timeline/ && bun build src/explore-data/main.ts --outdir dist/explore-data --entry-naming main.js --format iife --minify && cp src/explore-data/index.html src/explore-data/explore.css dist/explore-data/
